answers.genPolicy:2b6a95e1a43730adfb420758f3ecca:
[B1] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
[B3] < deviceB | 'key' : K , ... > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB
=> < deviceB | 'key' : K , ... > $ deviceB 'sendMsg' UserX | encrypt(FreshR , K) .
[B3] < UserX | 'msg' : nils , ... > $ deviceB 'sendMsg' UserX | encrypt(R , K)
=> < UserX | 'msg' : encrypt(R , K) , ... > .
[B4] < cloudA | deviceB : ('key' : K , 'owners' : Owners , ...) > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | encrypt(R , K)
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('key' : K , 'owners' : (UserX , Owners) , ...) > .
[B5] < cloudA | deviceB : ('owners' : (UserX , Owners) , ...) > $ UserX 'reset' cloudA | deviceB
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('owners' : (nils , Owners) , ...) > .
